Green Bone Broth Smoothie
By: Kettle and Fire
Published: Wednesday, June 14, 2017 - 3:52am

Ingredients




3-4 Kettle & Fire Beef Bone Broth ice cubes
1 cup spinach rinsed
1 banana peeled and sliced
1 green apple cored and sliced
1/2 cup water

Preparation

1 Make bone broth ice cubes the night prior by pouring Kettle and Fire Beef Bone Broth into ice tray. 2 Place the spinach, banana, and apple in a blender with ½ cup of water. Add 3-4 beef bone broth ice cubes. 3 Blend on high speed for 30-45 seconds or until smooth. Pour into a glass and enjoy!

About

Breakfast will never be the same once you try this Green Bone Broth Smoothie recipe. This is a frothy cold green smoothie packed with fiber, protein, and collagen!
